svg.title: Benchmark accuracy and cap-hit-rate differences: which method gives lower observed SD?

cc:Work.dc:title: Benchmark accuracy and cap-hit-rate differences: which method gives lower observed SD?
cc:Work.dc:description: Fixed response-budget allocations from saved paired evaluation groups. Solid lines are means; shading is plus or minus one observed standard deviation, not a confidence interval. Dotted references use all 1000 MMLU-Pro questions or 294 SciCode subtasks, each with 20 repetitions.
